classification.difficultyReason: Read the positive or negative intervals of already-factorised cubics with three distinct roots, including fractional roots and non-strict endpoints.

answer.worked:
Sketch $y=(x+2)(x-1)(x-3)$. Its zeroes are $-2$, $1$ and $3$, and its right-hand end rises.

The graph is above the $x$-axis for $-2<x<1$ and $x>3$. Exclude all three zeroes because the inequality is strict.

$-2<x<1$ or $x>3$.

spec.description: Authored cubic sketch with the three exact zeroes labelled.
